xna-type.name: IGraphicsDeviceService
xna-type.summary: Defines a mechanism for retrieving GraphicsDevice objects.

property.name: GraphicsDevice
property.syntax: public virtual abstract GraphicsDevice GraphicsDevice { get; }

event.name: DeviceCreated
event.summary: The event that occurs when a graphics device is created.
event.syntax: public virtual abstract event EventHandler DeviceCreated

event.name: DeviceDisposing
event.summary: The event that occurs when a graphics device is disposing.
event.syntax: public virtual abstract event EventHandler DeviceDisposing

event.name: DeviceReset
event.summary: The event that occurs when a graphics device is reset.
event.syntax: public virtual abstract event EventHandler DeviceReset

event.name: DeviceResetting
event.summary: The event that occurs when a graphics device is in the process of resetting.
event.syntax: public virtual abstract event EventHandler DeviceResetting
